Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 55: the slip of [[Vader's Personal Shuttle (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014). It prints errata version PC-E3 (“May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. Vader deploys -3 aboard. While Vader piloting at a battleground, maneuver +2 and you lose no Force to Uncontrollable Fury or You Must Confront Vader.”), word for word the text of [[Vader's Personal Shuttle (V) (Virtual Block 2)]].<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
